items.definition:
the study of human society
She decided to major in sociology at university.

the grip of a tire on a road or a shoe on a surface
The car lost traction on the icy road.

the amount of money a business takes in a period
The company's annual turnover increased significantly.

a form or version of something that differs
This is a new variant of the original design.

the state of being able to see or be seen
The fog reduced visibility on the road.

a thing that completes or brings to perfection
The new curtains perfectly complement the room's decor.

the subjugation and assumption of control of a place or people by use of military force
The Norman Conquest of England occurred in 1066.

decibel (unit of sound intensity)
The noise level reached 90 dB, which is very loud.

a shortcoming, imperfection, or lack
The car was recalled due to a manufacturing defect.

the action or process of draining something
The city improved the drainage system to prevent flooding.

impartial and just treatment or behavior without favoritism or discrimination
The judge was praised for his fairness in the trial.

a crime, typically one involving violence, regarded as more serious than a misdemeanor
Armed robbery is considered a serious felony.

a military stronghold, especially a strongly fortified town fit for a large garrison
The ancient fortress stood on a hill overlooking the city.

a person within a group or organization, especially someone with special knowledge
An insider leaked confidential information to the press.

the action of abducting someone and holding them captive
The police are investigating a case of kidnapping.

a furry growth of minute fungi; a hollow container used to give shape
There was mold growing on the old bread.

an expression or feeling of disapproval or opposition
The lawyer raised an objection to the question.

an incident or event
The sudden occurrence of the storm surprised everyone.

a support; an item used in a play
The old fence needed a prop to keep it from falling.

a place where registers or records are kept
You can find your birth certificate at the local registry office.

a conference or other meeting for discussion or training
She attended a seminar on digital marketing.

the quality or condition of being easy to understand or do
The beauty of the design lies in its simplicity.

a long musical composition for full orchestra
The orchestra performed a beautiful symphony by Beethoven.

any of the tubes forming part of the blood circulation system
Blood flows through the veins back to the heart.

a road passing around a town or village
They built a new bypass to ease traffic congestion.

a dead body, especially of a human being
The police found a corpse in the abandoned building.

cruel behavior or attitudes
Animal cruelty is a serious offense.

the action of choosing someone or something for a special purpose
His official designation is Senior Project Manager.

the sending of someone or something to a destination for a purpose
The police received a dispatch about a robbery.

the wife or widow of a duke
The Duchess attended the charity event.

the state or process of a species, family, or other group dying out
Many species are facing extinction due to climate change.

the study of the Earth's physical structure and substance
She is studying geology at university.

an area of open uncultivated land
The sheep grazed on the heath.

a person's way of thinking
He has a very positive mentality.

a colorless, odorless, gaseous element
Nitrogen is the most abundant gas in Earth's atmosphere.

a list of a company's employees and the amount of money they are to be paid
The company processes payroll every two weeks.

the action or fact of rising from the dead; a revival
The band's reunion was a resurrection of their former glory.

a vehicle for exploring; a wanderer
NASA sent a new rover to Mars.

an operation in which an organ is moved
He needed a heart transplant.

something successfully achieved
Finishing the marathon was a great accomplishment.

the forming or devising of a plan or idea
The original conception of the project was much simpler.

a person or thing holding a similar position or performing a similar function to another
The CEO met with his counterpart from the rival company.

the state of having the right to do or obtain something
Check your eligibility for the scholarship before applying.

an act of giving one's public approval or support to someone or something
The product received an endorsement from a famous athlete.

the best or most important one of a group of things
The new smartphone is the company's flagship product.

a simple sugar that is an important energy source
The body converts food into glucose for energy.

a circle of light or glory
The artist painted a halo around the angel's head.

a hard sedimentary rock
The cliffs were made of white limestone.

material made of a network of wire or thread
The window screen was made of fine mesh.

a foolish or stupid person
He called me a moron for making a simple mistake.

a building material; a weapon
The bricks were held together with mortar.

high status or regard
The university has a lot of academic prestige.

the quality of being closely connected or appropriate
His comments had no relevance to the discussion.

a person who settles in a new country or area
The early settlers faced many challenges.

a type of cloth or woven fabric
The factory produces various textiles.

a medicine that inhibits the growth of or destroys microorganisms
The doctor prescribed an antibiotic for the infection.

the action of looking forward to something
There was a sense of anticipation in the air before the concert.

a guiding light or signal
The lighthouse served as a beacon for ships at sea.

a meeting for giving information or instructions
The team received a detailed briefing before the mission.

a person who disputes or competes with another
The reigning champion faced a strong challenger in the final.

a state of deep unconsciousness
After the accident, he was in a coma for several days.

the act or fact of vanishing or ceasing to exist
The police are investigating the mysterious disappearance of the artifact.

a house, apartment, or other place of residence
The ancient dwelling was carved into the side of the cliff.

the branch of biology that deals with the relations of organisms to one another and to their physical surroundings
She is studying ecology at university.
